title: AblationBench: Evaluating Automated Planning of Ablations in Empirical AI Research
abstract: arXiv:2507.08038v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Language model agents are increasingly used to automate scientific research, yet evaluating their scientific contributions remains a challenge. A key mechanism to obtain such insights is through ablation experiments. To this end, we introduce AblationBench, a benchmark suite for evaluating agents on ablation planning tasks in empirical AI research. It includes two tasks: AuthorAblation, which helps authors propose ablation experiments based on a method section and contains 83 instances, and ReviewerAblation, which helps reviewers find missing ablations in a full paper and contains 350 instances. For both tasks, we develop LM-based judges that serve as an automatic evaluation framework. Our experiments with frontier LMs show that these tasks remain challenging, with the best-performing LM system identifying only 45% of the original ablations on average, below human-level performance. translated_title: AblationBench：评估实证AI研究中消融实验自动规划的基准
translated_abstract: 语言模型智能体越来越多地被用于自动化科学研究，然而评估其科学贡献仍然是一个挑战。获取此类洞察的一个关键机制是通过消融实验。为此，我们提出了AblationBench，这是一个用于评估智能体在实证AI研究中消融实验规划任务能力的基准套件。它包含两个任务：AuthorAblation，帮助作者基于论文方法章节提出消融实验，包含83个实例；ReviewerAblation，帮助审稿人发现完整论文中缺失的消融实验，包含350个实例。针对这两个任务，我们开发了基于语言模型的评判器作为自动评估框架。我们在前沿语言模型上的实验表明，这些任务仍然具有挑战性，表现最好的语言模型系统平均只能识别45%的原始消融实验，低于人类水平的表现。我们观察到两者之间呈现相反的性能趋势……
tldr: 该论文提出了AblationBench基准套件，通过AuthorAblation和ReviewerAblation两个任务及基于语言模型的自动评判框架，评估智能体在实证AI研究中规划消融实验的能力，发现前沿语言模型的表现（平均识别率仅45%）仍低于人类水平。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AblationBench, a benchmark suite with two tasks (AuthorAblation and ReviewerAblation) and LM-based judges to evaluate agents on ablation planning in empirical AI research, showing that frontier LMs identify only 45% of original ablations on average, below human-level performance.
